subject: Cross-region workshop — staffing windows, travel holds, and rehearsal plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@horizonsys.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizonsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed windows for Horizon Systems executive workshop (Nov–Dec)

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for agreeing to the on-site + virtual executive workshop to run the roadmap & inference runbook. To get us moving I wanted to propose a set of calendar holds and confirm staffing/travel constraints so we can reserve rooms and secure flights.

High-level ask from us:
- Can you confirm preferred week(s) between Nov 29–Dec 13 for a 2.5 day workshop? We’re proposing three potential hubs (Bay Area, London, Singapore) and will run a hybrid hub model with live stream between sites.
- Please confirm expected headcount per hub (attendee list by role).
- Any visa or travel policies we should be aware of (e.g., on-site passes, ID checks, preferred hotels)?

Proposed calendar holds (we'll send blocked invites once we have headcounts):
- Nov 29–30: Pre-workshop rehearsal & AV run (Redwood ops + Horizon AV lead) — all-day hold
- Dec 1–2 (AM): Exec workshop sessions (2.5 days with half-day wrap/field visits)

Attachments: draft agenda (HS-Workshop-Agenda-v2.pdf) and travel checklist (Travel-Checklist-Horizon.xlsx).

If those windows don't work, give us 2–3 alternatives and we'll pivot. We can support visa letters and preferred hotel lists once the week is locked.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Park <alex.park@horizonsys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizonsys.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed windows for Horizon Systems executive workshop (Nov–Dec)

Stephanie —

Thanks — helpful start. Quick notes from our side after internal sync:
- Preferred week: Nov 29–Dec 2 would be ideal; leadership travel is lighter then.
- Headcount: Bay Area hub ~8 (leadership + platform), London hub ~5 (product & ops), Singapore hub ~3 (regional lead). We may consolidate several APAC folks into London if travel windows tighten.
- Visa/travel: most EU/US attendees are fine; two APAC attendees will need visa letters for the US. We have a corporate travel policy that requires flight accommodation be booked through our TMC (Concur partner) — can you advise if Redwood will accept TMC invoicing or need direct traveler receipts?

AV needs:
- Two studios with mics & live-captioning for each hub; recording required for internal distribution.

We'll confirm attendee names by EOD Friday. Can Redwood support a fixed rehearsal date on Nov 28 (late afternoon) for cross-site testing?

Best,
Alex
VP Product, Horizon Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Proposed windows for Horizon Systems executive workshop (internal coordination)

All — looping in logistics notes and ops tasks. I’m booking the Bay Area studio and provisional hotel block (Hilton SF Union Square) for Nov 27–Dec 3; will request the 10-room block but can scale with final headcount. Connor — can you confirm AV vendor availability for Nov 28 rehearsal and provide cost estimate?

Action items:
- Connor: confirm AV quote + list of required in-room kit (streams, captioning) by 11/22.
- Vivek: do we have visa letter template & expedited processing notes we can pass to Horizon?
- Stephanie: I'll draft calendar holds after Alex shares final names.

Attaching the updated agenda with session leads (HS-Workshop-Agenda-v2.pdf).

—Marissa
Event Programs Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@horizonsys.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T09:15:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Proposed windows for Horizon Systems executive workshop (visa support & lead times)

Hi Alex / Team —

We can provide formal invitation/visa letters for the two APAC attendees. A few notes on timelines:
- Standard letters: 2 business days turnaround once we have full legal names, DOB, passport number, and purpose of travel.
- Expedited process (3–4 business days) available if we get documents by Nov 25 COB.
- For payment: we can accept TMC invoicing via Concur as long as flights are routed through the traveler and redwood receives invoice copy. We will work with finance to ensure the hotel master bill and incidentals are handled per your policy.

Connor — please include the rehearsal runbook items (network port requirements, streaming ingest endpoints) in the rehearsal invite so Horizon ops can validate firewall rules.

—Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@horizonsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@horizonsys.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Confirming Nov 28–Dec 2 windows and next steps (calendar holds to follow)

Alex / Priya —

Great — thanks for the quick turn. Confirming the plan:
- Rehearsal: Nov 28, 3:00–6:00pm PT (cross-hub test & captioning check)
- Workshop: Nov 29 (AM)–Dec 2 (noon) — Bay Area primary hub; London + Singapore run synchronized sessions per agenda.

Next actions we will take today:
- I will send calendar hold invites for Nov 28–Dec 2 to the attendee list you provide (please send final names & titles by 11/30 5pm PT).
- Marissa will finalize the hotel master block and confirm rooming list template.
- Connor will circulate AV quote and rehearsal runbook with streaming endpoints.
- Vivek will prepare visa letters for APAC attendees if we receive passport details by 11/30.

Attachments & links: drive folder with final materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHS-workshop-materials (agenda, room layouts, travel checklist). DocuSign link for the workshop SOW to follow.

If anything changes to leadership availability we can pivot to the alternate week Dec 6–10 but we'd prefer to keep Nov 29–Dec 2.

Thanks everyone — calendar holds and invites will follow once names are in.

—Stephanie
Director, Solutions & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
